name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) - Full Practice Pack 100
title: AWS CLF-C02 Full Practice Pack - 100 Questions
description: 100 unique original CLF-C02-style questions aligned approximately to the official domain weighting.

questions.question: A startup wants to avoid purchasing servers upfront and instead pay only for resources it consumes. Which AWS Cloud benefit does this illustrate?
options: Trade fixed expense for variable expense
questions.explanation: AWS lets customers replace large upfront capital investments with variable, consumption-based spending.

questions.question: An online retailer automatically adds compute capacity during a flash sale and removes it afterward. Which cloud concept is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: Elasticity means dynamically adding or removing resources as demand changes.

questions.question: A company wants its application to remain available even if a single AWS data center has an outage. Which approach BEST supports this goal?
options: Place all resources in one subnet
Deploy resources across multiple Availability Zones
questions.explanation: Using multiple Availability Zones reduces dependency on a single physical location and improves availability.

questions.question: Which AWS Cloud advantage allows a company to deploy an application in another geographic area within minutes rather than building a new data center?
questions.explanation: AWS Regions allow organizations to deploy workloads globally without constructing their own facilities.

questions.question: Which term describes the ability of a system to increase its capacity to accommodate growth?
questions.explanation: Scalability is the ability to increase or decrease system capacity to meet workload requirements.

questions.question: A company designs an application so that failure of one component does not make the entire application unavailable. Which design principle is being applied?
questions.explanation: Cloud architectures should anticipate failures and use redundancy and automated recovery.

questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar focuses on avoiding unnecessary costs and selecting resources based on economic requirements?
questions.explanation: The Cost Optimization pillar focuses on delivering business value at the lowest appropriate cost.

questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected pillar focuses on the ability of a workload to perform its intended function correctly and consistently when expected?
questions.explanation: Reliability covers recovery from disruptions, resource acquisition, and consistent workload operation.

questions.question: A team wants to improve procedures, learn from operational events, and automate operational changes. Which Well-Architected pillar is MOST relevant?
questions.explanation: Operational Excellence focuses on running and monitoring systems and continuously improving processes and procedures.

questions.question: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on using computing resources efficiently as requirements and technologies evolve?
questions.explanation: Performance Efficiency is about efficient use of computing resources and adapting to changing demand and technology.

questions.question: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on protecting information, systems, and assets while delivering business value?
questions.explanation: The Security pillar focuses on protecting data, systems, and assets through risk assessment and mitigation.

questions.question: Which Well-Architected pillar focuses on minimizing the environmental impacts of running cloud workloads?
questions.explanation: The Sustainability pillar focuses on minimizing environmental impact by improving resource efficiency.

questions.question: A company wants a structured framework for assessing cloud readiness and creating a transformation roadmap. Which AWS resource is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: AWS CAF provides guidance for cloud readiness, transformation, governance, people, platform, security, and operations.

questions.question: Which migration strategy involves moving an application to AWS with minimal changes to its architecture?
questions.explanation: Rehosting, often called lift-and-shift, moves applications with minimal architectural change.

questions.question: A company replaces its self-managed CRM application with a cloud-based SaaS product. Which migration strategy is this?
questions.explanation: Repurchase means moving to a different product, commonly a SaaS solution.

questions.question: A company decides that an old application is no longer needed and will not migrate it to AWS. Which migration strategy applies?
questions.explanation: Retire means decommissioning applications that are no longer required.

questions.question: A company modifies an application to use managed AWS services and cloud-native capabilities to gain greater scalability. Which migration strategy is this?
questions.explanation: Refactoring changes the application architecture to take fuller advantage of cloud-native capabilities.

questions.question: What is an economic benefit of AWS economies of scale?
options: AWS can achieve lower variable costs because usage is aggregated across many customers
AWS eliminates the need to monitor costs
All services have identical pricing worldwide
Every customer receives free unlimited compute
questions.explanation: Large-scale aggregated usage enables AWS to achieve economies that can translate into lower variable costs.

questions.question: A company frequently overprovisions its on-premises servers to handle rare peak loads. Which AWS benefit can MOST directly reduce this inefficiency?
questions.explanation: Elastic capacity lets organizations align resources more closely with actual demand.

questions.question: Which statement BEST describes high availability?
options: A workload can only run in one Region
A system always uses the largest server available
A system is designed to remain accessible despite component failures
questions.explanation: High availability uses redundancy and resilient design to minimize downtime.

questions.question: Which concept describes a system's ability to continue functioning even when some components fail?
questions.explanation: Fault tolerance enables continued operation despite component failures.

questions.question: A business wants developers to experiment quickly without waiting weeks for hardware procurement. Which AWS benefit is MOST relevant?
options: Centralize all workloads in one data center
questions.explanation: On-demand provisioning allows teams to experiment and deploy much faster.

questions.question: Which cloud economics practice helps reduce waste by matching resource size to actual workload requirements?
questions.explanation: Rightsizing aligns resource types and sizes with workload needs to avoid unnecessary spend.

questions.question: A company wants to measure business value from cloud adoption, including agility, cost savings, resilience, and staff productivity. What broad concept is it evaluating?
questions.explanation: The cloud value proposition includes economic and operational benefits such as agility, elasticity, resilience, and cost optimization.

questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for physical security of AWS data centers?
questions.explanation: AWS is responsible for security OF the cloud, including facilities, hardware, and underlying infrastructure.

questions.question: For an Amazon EC2 instance, who is generally responsible for patching the guest operating system?
questions.explanation: For EC2, customers manage the guest OS, including patching and configuration.

questions.question: For Amazon RDS, which task is AWS responsible for as part of the managed service?
options: Patching the underlying database infrastructure and managed OS
questions.explanation: AWS manages more of the underlying infrastructure for RDS, while customers remain responsible for their data and access configuration.

questions.question: Which AWS service manages users, groups, roles, and permissions to AWS resources?
questions.explanation: IAM controls authentication and authorization to AWS resources.

questions.question: An EC2 application needs temporary permissions to read an S3 bucket. Which approach follows AWS best practices?
options: Store root credentials in the application
Hard-code an IAM user's long-term keys
Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instance
questions.explanation: IAM roles provide temporary credentials and avoid embedding long-term secrets.

questions.question: Which security principle recommends granting only the permissions required to perform a task?
questions.explanation: Least privilege minimizes risk by granting only necessary permissions.

questions.question: What additional security mechanism should be enabled for privileged AWS users to reduce the risk of password compromise?
questions.explanation: MFA requires an additional authentication factor beyond the password.

questions.question: Which AWS service records API activity performed by users, roles, and AWS services for auditing?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail records AWS account activity and API events.

questions.question: Which AWS service continuously analyzes supported data sources to detect suspicious activity and potential threats?
questions.explanation: GuardDuty is a managed threat detection service.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides automated vulnerability management for supported EC2 workloads, Lambda functions, and ECR container images?
questions.explanation: Amazon Inspector scans supported workloads for vulnerabilities and exposure.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps discover and classify sensitive data stored in Amazon S3?
questions.explanation: Macie uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover sensitive data in S3.

questions.question: Which service helps protect web applications from common web exploits by filtering HTTP(S) requests?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF lets customers define web ACL rules to filter malicious or unwanted web requests.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides managed protection against distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks?
questions.explanation: AWS Shield provides DDoS protection for AWS workloads.

questions.question: A company wants to centrally view and prioritize security findings from services such as GuardDuty and Inspector. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: Security Hub aggregates and helps prioritize security findings across supported AWS services.

questions.question: Which AWS service is designed to create and control encryption keys used to protect data?
questions.explanation: AWS KMS is a managed service for creating and controlling cryptographic keys.

questions.question: A company wants to store database passwords securely and rotate them automatically. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: Secrets Manager securely stores secrets and supports automatic rotation for supported use cases.

questions.question: Which AWS service can provision and manage public and private SSL/TLS certificates for supported AWS services?
questions.explanation: ACM simplifies provisioning and lifecycle management of SSL/TLS certificates.

questions.question: A company needs on-demand access to AWS compliance reports and agreements. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact provides access to AWS security and compliance documents and agreements.

questions.question: Which service records configuration changes to supported AWS resources and can evaluate them against desired rules?
questions.explanation: AWS Config tracks resource configuration and can evaluate compliance using rules.

questions.question: A company has many AWS accounts and wants to restrict which AWS services or actions member accounts can use. Which feature should it use?
options: Service control policies (SCPs) in AWS Organizations
questions.explanation: SCPs set permission guardrails for accounts in an AWS Organization.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps centrally manage multiple AWS accounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations provides centralized multi-account management and governance capabilities.

questions.question: A company wants workforce users to sign in once and access multiple AWS accounts and business applications. Which service is designed for this?
questions.explanation: IAM Identity Center provides centralized workforce access to multiple AWS accounts and applications.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a managed landing-zone capability to set up and govern a secure multi-account AWS environment?
questions.explanation: AWS Control Tower automates setup and governance of multi-account AWS environments using established best practices.

questions.question: What is the recommended practice for the AWS account root user?
options: Create root access keys for applications
Use it only for tasks that specifically require root credentials and enable MFA
questions.explanation: Root credentials have unrestricted access and should be tightly protected and used only when necessary.

questions.question: A company wants a private connection from resources in a VPC to Amazon S3 without sending traffic through the public internet. Which feature can provide this?
questions.explanation: A VPC endpoint enables private connectivity to supported AWS services without requiring internet traversal.

questions.question: Which statement about security groups is correct?
options: They are stateful virtual firewalls associated with resources such as EC2 instances
They are stateless and operate only at the AWS Region boundary
questions.explanation: Security groups are stateful network access controls commonly associated with ENIs and EC2 instances.

questions.question: Which statement about network ACLs is correct?
options: They are stateless controls applied at the subnet level
They are stateful controls attached to IAM users
questions.explanation: Network ACLs are stateless network filters that operate at the subnet boundary.

questions.question: A company wants to prevent accidental public access to S3 buckets across an account. Which capability is MOST relevant?
questions.explanation: S3 Block Public Access provides centralized controls to limit public access to buckets and objects.

questions.question: Which service helps investigate the root cause of suspicious security findings by analyzing relationships and activity across AWS resources?
questions.explanation: Amazon Detective assists security investigations by analyzing and visualizing security-related data.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides centralized policy management for AWS WAF rules, Shield Advanced protections, and certain other security controls across accounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Firewall Manager helps centrally configure and manage firewall and protection policies across accounts and resources.

questions.question: Which AWS compute service provides resizable virtual servers in the cloud?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 provides resizable virtual compute instances.

questions.question: Which service runs code in response to events without requiring customers to provision servers?
questions.explanation: Lambda is serverless compute that executes code in response to events.

questions.question: Which AWS service automatically adjusts the number of EC2 instances in response to demand?
questions.explanation: EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts instance capacity based on policies and demand.

questions.question: Which service distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets such as EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing distributes traffic across healthy targets to improve availability and scalability.

questions.question: Which service offers a simplified way to launch virtual private servers, storage, and networking for small applications?
questions.explanation: Lightsail provides simplified cloud resources for smaller or straightforward workloads.

questions.question: A company wants to run containers without managing EC2 servers. Which AWS compute option can provide serverless container capacity?
questions.explanation: Fargate provides serverless compute capacity for supported container orchestration services.

questions.question: Which managed service is designed to run and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes?
questions.explanation: Amazon EKS is AWS's managed Kubernetes service.

questions.question: Which managed service provides container orchestration using AWS-native technology?
questions.explanation: Amazon ECS is a fully managed AWS container orchestration service.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides scalable object storage?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 provides highly scalable object storage.

questions.question: Which storage service provides block storage volumes primarily for use with EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Amazon EBS provides persistent block-level storage for EC2 workloads.

questions.question: Multiple Linux EC2 instances need to access the same managed file system concurrently. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: Amazon EFS provides managed shared file storage that can be mounted by multiple Linux-based resources.

questions.question: Which S3 storage class is designed for long-term archival data that is rarely accessed and can tolerate longer retrieval times?
questions.explanation: S3 Glacier Deep Archive is optimized for very low-cost, long-term archival storage.

questions.question: A company wants S3 objects to automatically move to lower-cost storage classes as they age. Which feature should it configure?
questions.explanation: S3 Lifecycle rules automate transitions between storage classes and expiration.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a managed relational database?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS provides managed relational database engines.

questions.question: Which AWS database is a MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database designed for the cloud?
questions.explanation: Aurora is a cloud-optimized relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.

questions.question: Which database service is a serverless NoSQL key-value and document database?
questions.explanation: DynamoDB is a managed serverless NoSQL database.

questions.question: Which AWS service is primarily designed as a cloud data warehouse for analytics?
questions.explanation: Amazon Redshift is a managed cloud data warehouse for analytics workloads.

questions.question: Which service provides managed in-memory caching to improve application performance?
questions.explanation: ElastiCache provides managed Redis/Valkey and Memcached-compatible in-memory caching capabilities.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides scalable DNS and domain registration?
questions.explanation: Route 53 provides DNS, domain registration, and health-checking capabilities.

questions.question: Which service is AWS's content delivery network (CDN)?
questions.explanation: CloudFront caches and delivers content through a global edge network.

questions.question: A company requires a dedicated private network connection from its data center to AWS. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect provides dedicated connectivity between customer locations and AWS.

questions.question: Which AWS networking service enables customers to create an isolated virtual network in AWS?
questions.explanation: Amazon VPC lets customers define logically isolated virtual networks.

questions.question: Which VPC component allows resources in a public subnet to communicate with the internet?
questions.explanation: An internet gateway enables communication between a VPC and the internet when routing and addressing are configured appropriately.

questions.question: Private-subnet EC2 instances need outbound internet access for software updates but should not accept unsolicited inbound internet connections. Which service is commonly used?
options: Internet gateway attached directly to each instance
questions.explanation: A NAT gateway enables outbound internet connectivity for private-subnet resources while preventing unsolicited inbound connections.

questions.question: Which AWS service collects metrics, logs, and alarms for monitoring AWS resources and applications?
questions.explanation: CloudWatch provides monitoring, metrics, logs, dashboards, and alarms.

questions.question: A company wants to define AWS infrastructure using templates so environments can be created consistently. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: CloudFormation provides infrastructure as code using declarative templates.

questions.question: Which browser-based shell provides command-line access to AWS without requiring local installation of the AWS CLI?
questions.explanation: CloudShell provides a browser-based shell with AWS tooling and authenticated access.

questions.question: Which service helps centrally view and manage application and infrastructure resources and automate operational tasks such as patching supported managed nodes?
questions.explanation: Systems Manager provides operational management capabilities including inventory, automation, and patch management.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps migrate databases to AWS with minimal downtime for many migration scenarios?
questions.explanation: AWS DMS helps migrate databases to AWS and supports ongoing replication for reduced downtime.

questions.question: A company needs to transfer tens of terabytes of data to AWS from a location with limited network bandwidth. Which AWS family of physical devices can help?
questions.explanation: AWS Snow Family devices support offline or edge data transfer when network transfer is impractical.

questions.question: Which service accelerates online transfer of files between on-premises storage and AWS storage services?
questions.explanation: DataSync is a managed data transfer service for moving data between on-premises storage, edge locations, and AWS storage.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides managed message queues to decouple application components?
questions.explanation: Amazon SQS provides durable managed message queues that help decouple distributed application components.

questions.question: An application must send the same notification to multiple subscribers using a publish/subscribe model. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: Amazon SNS is a managed pub/sub messaging service that can fan out messages to multiple subscribers.

questions.question: Which AWS service lets users query data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL without managing servers?
questions.explanation: Athena is a serverless interactive query service for data in S3.

questions.question: Which AWS tool helps estimate the cost of a planned architecture before resources are deployed?
questions.explanation: AWS Pricing Calculator estimates costs for planned AWS workloads.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps visualize and analyze historical AWS costs and usage?
questions.explanation: Cost Explorer provides cost and usage visualization, analysis, and forecasting capabilities.

questions.question: A company wants an alert when actual or forecasted monthly AWS spending exceeds a defined amount. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets supports cost and usage thresholds with notifications.

questions.question: A fault-tolerant batch workload can be interrupted and restarted. Which EC2 purchasing option can provide the largest discounts compared with On-Demand pricing?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity at steep discounts and suit interruption-tolerant workloads.

questions.question: Which EC2 pricing model is appropriate when a workload has short-term, irregular usage and the customer does not want a long-term commitment?
questions.explanation: On-Demand pricing is appropriate for flexible workloads without long-term commitment.

questions.question: A company has predictable compute usage and is willing to make a usage commitment in exchange for lower prices across eligible compute services. Which pricing option is MOST relevant?
questions.explanation: Savings Plans offer lower prices in exchange for a consistent usage commitment over a term.

questions.question: Which AWS capability allows charges from multiple member accounts in an AWS Organization to be combined on one bill?
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing combines charges from accounts within an AWS Organization.

questions.question: Which cost allocation mechanism can help a company categorize AWS charges by project, department, or environment?
questions.explanation: Activated cost allocation tags can be used to categorize and analyze AWS costs.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides recommendations in areas such as cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits depending on available checks?
questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor evaluates AWS environments against best-practice checks and provides recommendations.

questions.question: Where can AWS customers create and manage technical support cases when their support plan includes case creation?
questions.explanation: AWS Support Center is used to create and manage AWS Support cases.

questions.question: Which AWS resource is a community-driven question-and-answer service for technical AWS questions?
questions.explanation: AWS re:Post is an AWS-managed community knowledge service for technical questions and answers.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides information about events and changes that can affect a customer's AWS resources and services?
questions.explanation: AWS Health provides visibility into events and changes that may affect AWS services and customer resources.
